post.title: Top 5 Tips for a Spotless Home
post.author: Priya Sharma
post.intro: Keeping your living spaces pristine doesn't have to be an overwhelming weekend chore. By breaking down household maintenance into smart, actionable routines, you can enjoy a fresh, clean environment every single day.
post.body: Maintaining a clean and hygienic space has a direct impact on your well-being, comfort, and peace of mind. Regular deep cleaning eliminates microscopic allergens, prevents mold buildup, and creates an environment where everyone can breathe easily and thrive. Our professional team recommends adopting systematic daily habits combined with periodic seasonal deep cleans to keep your property looking and feeling its very best.
post.subtext: Focus on high-touch zones, establish a 15-minute daily reset, and use quality microfibre cloths with the proper eco-friendly cleaning agents.
post.quote: A clean space is not just about appearances—it is the foundation of good health, productivity, and peace of mind.
post.closing: Investing time and attention into regular, eco-friendly cleaning protects your family, delights your guests, and prolongs the lifespan of your furnishings. At Avicleaner, our mission is to make sparkling, sanitary spaces accessible and hassle-free for every home and business.

CleaningFaq1.label: FAQ’s
CleaningFaq1.description: Find quick answers to common questions about our cleaning services, booking process, pricing, and more. If you need further assistance, feel free to contact our team.

image.alt: Avicleaner cleaning supplies ready for use

faqs.question: What cleaning services do you offer?
faqs.answer: We offer a wide range of cleaning services including home cleaning, office cleaning, kitchen cleaning, bathroom cleaning, window cleaning, deep cleaning, and move in/out cleaning. Our services are customizable to meet your specific needs.

faqs.question: How do I book a cleaning service?
faqs.answer: Booking is quick and easy. Fill in the form on our Book Now page or call us, choose the service, date and time that suit you, and our team will confirm your booking within minutes.

faqs.question: Are your cleaning products safe?
faqs.answer: Yes. We use eco-friendly, non-toxic cleaning products that are safe for your family, pets and the environment, while still being tough on dirt and germs.

faqs.question: How much do your services cost?
faqs.answer: Our pricing depends on the type of service and the size of your space. Plans start from $49.99 per month with no hidden charges. Visit our Pricing page to compare plans or contact us for a custom quote.

faqs.question: Do I need to provide cleaning supplies?
faqs.answer: No. Our team arrives fully equipped with professional cleaning supplies and equipment. If you would like us to use specific products, just let us know when booking.

faqs.question: How long does a cleaning session take?
faqs.answer: A standard cleaning session usually takes 2 to 4 hours, depending on the size and condition of your space. Deep cleaning and move in/out cleaning may take longer.

faqs.question: Do you offer same-day cleaning?
faqs.answer: Yes, same-day cleaning is available subject to team availability. Call us as early as possible and we will do our best to schedule your cleaning the same day.

faqs.question: What if I’m not satisfied with the cleaning?
faqs.answer: Your satisfaction is our priority. If you are not happy with any part of the service, let us know within 24 hours and we will come back and re-clean the area at no extra cost.

CleaningRefundPolicy1.label: Refund & Cancellation
CleaningRefundPolicy1.intro: We understand that plans can change. This Refund & Cancellation Policy explains how you can cancel or reschedule a booking, when fees may apply, and how refunds are handled for our cleaning services.

sections.title: Cancellation by You
sections.text: You may cancel a booking at any time by contacting us by phone or email. The notice you give determines whether a fee applies:
points: More than 24 hours before the scheduled time: free cancellation.
Less than 24 hours before the scheduled time: a late cancellation fee of up to 50% of the service price may apply.
After our team has arrived, or if we cannot access the property: the full service price may be charged.

sections.title: Rescheduling
sections.text: You can reschedule your booking free of charge with at least 24 hours' notice, subject to availability. Rescheduling requests made with less than 24 hours' notice may be treated as a late cancellation.

sections.title: Cancellation by Avicleaner
sections.text: On rare occasions we may need to cancel or reschedule a booking due to severe weather, staff illness, safety concerns, or other circumstances beyond our control. If this happens, we will notify you as early as possible and offer a new time or a full refund of any amount already paid.

sections.title: Satisfaction Guarantee & Re-Clean
sections.text: If you are not happy with the quality of our service, please contact us within 24 hours of completion with details of the issue. We will return and re-clean the affected areas at no additional cost before any refund is considered.

sections.title: Refund Eligibility
sections.text: A full or partial refund may be issued in the following situations:
points: You cancelled a prepaid booking within the free cancellation period.
We cancelled the booking and could not offer a suitable alternative time.
The issue could not be resolved after a re-clean.
You were charged incorrectly or more than once.

sections.title: Non-Refundable Situations
sections.text: Refunds are generally not provided in the following situations:
points: The complaint was reported more than 24 hours after the service was completed.
Our team was not given access to the property at the scheduled time.
The service was completed as described at the time of booking.
The issue was caused by pre-existing conditions that cleaning cannot fix.

sections.title: Refund Process & Timeline
sections.text: Approved refunds are issued to the original payment method. Please allow 5 to 7 business days for the amount to appear in your account, depending on your bank or card provider.

sections.title: Changes to This Policy
sections.text: We may update this Refund & Cancellation Policy from time to time. Any changes will be posted on this page with an updated effective date.

sections.text: We provide residential and commercial cleaning services as described on our website. The exact scope of each job is confirmed at the time of booking, and any work outside that scope may be quoted and charged separately.

sections.title: Bookings & Scheduling
sections.text: Bookings are subject to availability and are confirmed only once you receive a confirmation from us. We aim to arrive within the agreed time window, but arrival times may vary slightly due to traffic, weather, or earlier appointments.

sections.title: Pricing & Payment
sections.text: Prices are based on the details you provide when booking. If the property size or condition differs significantly from what was described, the final price may be adjusted with your approval before work begins.
points: Payment is due on completion of the service unless agreed otherwise in writing.
Quoted prices include standard cleaning supplies and equipment.
Overdue payments may result in suspension of future bookings.

sections.title: Customer Responsibilities
sections.text: To help us deliver the best possible result, we ask that you:
points: Provide safe access to the property, along with working water and electricity.
Secure or put away valuables, cash, and fragile or sentimental items.
Keep pets safely secured for the duration of the service.
Tell us in advance about any hazards, delicate surfaces, or special instructions.

sections.title: Cancellations & Rescheduling
sections.text: Cancellations, rescheduling, and refunds are handled according to our Refund & Cancellation Policy, which forms part of these Terms & Conditions.

sections.title: Satisfaction Guarantee

sections.title: Damage & Liability
sections.text: Our team takes great care in every property. Any damage must be reported within 24 hours of the service so we can investigate.
